widgets_values:
## MiniMax Music 3

A music generation model by MiniMax that creates complete songs up to 5 minutes long with stable structure and high audio quality. Two inputs drive it: **Caption** (structured music description: style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and **Lyrics** (with `[intro]` `[verse]` `[chorus]` `[bridge]` `[outro]` tags controlling song structure).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| Caption | Music description. Write it in three sections — Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement. The more specific, the closer the result. |
| Lyrics | Song lyrics + section tags. Tags are the only executable structural instructions; the lyric text itself only conveys mood. |
| max_duration | Target song length in seconds (default 120 = 2 minutes; the model supports up to ~300 s / 5 minutes). Longer songs take more time and VRAM. |
| seed | Random seed for the generation. Keep it fixed to reproduce the same song; change it to get a different take. |
| Model files | diffusion model / text encoder / VAE.|
| Tiled decode | Decode the audio VAE in overlapping tiles to drastically cut VRAM usage — helpful for long songs on low-VRAM GPUs. Slightly slower, with a small risk of seams at tile boundaries; turn it off on high-VRAM GPUs for the best quality. |

### Prompt Writing Guide

You can find an official [Music Caption Rewriter Skill here](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3)

# MiniMax Music 3（RH-core 版）使用说明

## 与优化版的区别
- 去掉了三方节点（Comfyroll 的 CR Prompt Text / Float），描述与歌词直接在 42 节点内编辑
- 时长默认 60 秒（RH 首发跑通优先，成本减半；想加长：2 分钟填 130-150，3 分钟填 200，上限 300）

## 用法（3 步）
1. 双击 42，改 caption（音乐描述，全局→人声→编曲三段式）与 lyrics（[Intro]/[Verse]/[Chorus] 结构标签）
2. 49 管随机种子（复现同一首），54 时长已并入 42 的 max_duration
3. 运行 → 47 采样 → 51 选解码（false=标准高音质 / true=分块省显存）→ 35 输出 mp3

## 模型（RH/本地都要先就位，约 11-14GB）
- diffusion_models/minimax_music3_dit_fp16.safetensors（16G 卡换 int8_convrot）
- text_encoders/minimax_music3_text_encoder_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
- vae/minimax_music3_dav.safetensors

## 排障
- 节点红/Unknown node type → ComfyUI 版本太旧（需 0.31+，建议最新 0.33+）
- 跑到一半 OOM → 41 换 int8 DiT + 51 拨 true（分块解码）
- RH 上模型选择器找不到文件 → 先到 RH 模型库确认三个文件存在，否则运行必然失败

widgets_values:
Global Metadata: Lo-fi hip-hop, chillhop with a Ming dynasty ink-wash flavor. 78 BPM, D flat major, major scale with pentatonic color and jazzy extensions. Laid-back and dreamy throughout, a gentle warm drift like lantern light on wet tile roofs and ink blooming on rice paper — deepening in the middle with a hint of night-market warmth, dissolving softly at the end. Night walks through lantern-lit streets, rain on the eaves, quiet teahouse conversations, the calm before a plot turn. Bedroom production: muddy warm texture, heavy vinyl crackle over the rain like old paper, tape hiss and wow-flutter pitch wobble, low-passed dusty mix, soft-clipped drums, everything slightly detuned and cozy.
Vocal Details: Soft androgynous vocal, hushed half-sung half-spoken delivery, sitting low in the mix like another instrument, lazy behind-the-beat phrasing, gentle breathy timbre. Sparse murmured double-tracked harmonies, occasional wordless "mmm" and "ooh" hums drenched in tape delay and warm spring reverb. Long stretches with no vocals at all.
Arrangement: Dusty boom-bap drums with a soft thumping kick, cracked snare with lazy swing, brushed hi-hats, low round sub bass. Warm Rhodes piano chords with slow chorus wobble as the harmonic bed, plucked guzheng arpeggios threading through the changes, mellow jazzy guitar and pipa licks answering the vocal lines, constant vinyl crackle as texture. Intro: rain and vinyl noise, solo Rhodes chords with one guzheng note fading in, drums slipping in halfway. Verses: minimal — drums, bass, Rhodes, guzheng, soft guitar and pipa fills between lines. Instrumental sections: pipa and Rhodes trade relaxed jazzy phrases over the beat, a distant erhu line and occasional muted trumpet ghost notes far in the background. Bridge: drums drop away to rain, crackle, and floating detuned Rhodes with a single plucked guzheng note, then the beat eases back in. Outro: elements fade one by one until only rain, vinyl crackle, and a last unresolved Rhodes chord remain.

[Intro]
Mmm...
(rain on the eaves)
Ooh...
(ink on the page)
[Verse]
Midnight and the ink still glows
Drag a brush along where the river flows
Paint a quiet dream, let the brush just drift
Ink into a mountain, like the fog just lifts
Twenty slow strokes, I'm in no hurry now
Rain becomes a river and I don't know how
Every scroll's a memory I found
Soft focus mountains, no sound
[Instrumental]
[Verse]
Draft another lantern, let the shadows breathe
Figures start to move like the falling leaves
Story drifting by on the lantern light
Little ink spirits dancing through the night
Verse after verse like the rain outside
Some of them are keepers, some I let slide
Save the ones that feel like a Sunday slow
Scroll to scroll to scroll... and off we go
[Chorus]
Mmm... let the ink flow on
(take your time, take your time)
Ooh... by the morning it'll all be done
(one more stroke, one more try)
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Rain keeps drawing rivers on the glass...
My brush keeps dreaming...
Neither of us fast...
[Chorus]
Mmm... let the ink flow on
(take your time, take your time)
Ooh... by the morning it'll all be done
(one more stroke, one more try)
[Instrumental]
[Outro]
Mmm...
(scroll to scroll)
Ooh... goodnight
